name: Obligation 8
definition: General information about the collateral agreement.

PartyA.name: Party A
PartyA.definition: One of the entities associated with the collateral agreement

ServicingPartyA.name: Servicing Party A
ServicingPartyA.definition: Party that is acting on behalf of party A and that offers collateral management services.

PartyB.name: Party B
PartyB.definition: Other entity associated with the collateral agreement

ServicingPartyB.name: Servicing Party B
ServicingPartyB.definition: Party that is acting on behalf of party B and that offers collateral management services.

CollateralAccountIdentification.name: Collateral Account Identification
CollateralAccountIdentification.definition: Provides additional information on the collateral account of the party delivering/receiving the collateral.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of collateral account for digital assets.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Underlying business area or type of trade causing the collateral movement.

CollateralSide.name: Collateral Side
CollateralSide.definition: Specifies whether the client is the collateral taker or giver.

ValuationDate.name: Valuation Date
ValuationDate.definition: Close of business date on which the initiating party is valuing the margin call.

ClosingDate.name: Closing Date
ClosingDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date/time at which the instructing party requests the instruction to be executed.

SettlementProcess.name: Settlement Process
SettlementProcess.definition: Specifies the settlement process in which the collateral will be settled.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rul.definition: If CollateralAccountIdentification is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rul.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, CollateralAccountIdentification must be absent.
